title: Employ staff under the Cleaning Services Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Cleaning Services Award 2020.

sources.title: Cleaning Services Award 2020
sources.quote: This industry award covers, to the exclusion of any other modern award: (a) employers in the contract cleaning services industry throughout Australia;

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Cleaning Services Award 2020
sources.quote: contract cleaning services industry means the business of providing cleaning services under a contract

reach.note: Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Cleaning Services Award 2020
sources.quote: contract cleaning services industry means the business of providing cleaning services under a contract

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: Only contract cleaning is covered; businesses cleaning their own premises are covered by their own industry's award.
